def: A dataset of over 2,000 open-ended web tasks on 137 real websites across 31 domains, with crowdsourced action sequences, for building and evaluating generalist web agents (Deng et al., 2023).
practice: Its live successor Online-Mind2Web (300 tasks on 136 websites) found earlier web-agent results over-optimistic and grades with an LLM judge at about 85% agreement with humans; date any live-site score.
